integrity: Complete analytic proof and an embedded reproducible exact-symbolic and numerical checker; finite checks supplement rather than replace the proof.
scientific_limitations: The signed comparison is proved for two-stage Coxian renewal times and a time-independent finite-dimensional unitary evolution, not arbitrary clocks, finite-time states, or dissipative channels. The pure-state overlap is squared fidelity; for mixed reset states it is not fidelity. Earlier general renewal formulas imply the matrix-transform starting point, so specialized publication priority remains to be independently assessed.
title: Clock-variance sign reversal of stationary quantum purity and reset overlap
